content:
Elastic Path has been preaching composable since before the MACH Alliance existed. Now they're shipping the tools that make it practical.

In this issue

  • The November 2025 Triple Launch. In November 2025, Elastic Path shipped three new native services at once:
  • The MCP Server (This Is the Interesting Part). One week after the triple launch, Elastic Path released a Developer MCP Server.
  • The Honest Assessment. Modularity is real, not marketing. You can adopt PXM for product management without touching their checkout.
  • The MACH Alliance Question. Elastic Path is not in the MACH Alliance. The company that arguably did more to popularize composable commerce than anyone else is not in the industry group that promotes composable commerce.
  • Who Should Look at Elastic Path. If you're a B2B brand with complex product configurations and you've outgrown your monolith, Elastic Path belongs on your shortlist.
